limitations: This report prepares and validates a real-CAD cleanup evidence package; it is not external safety certification.
The current default package is NOT_READY until real source CAD, cleaned geometry, hashes, provenance, and cleanup checks are supplied.
The production scorecard can clear the real-CAD blocker only after a validated large-layout CAD manifest is attached to the campaign manifest.

quality_gate_matrix.gap: Provide real_cad_cleanup_manifest.json in the package root.
quality_gate_matrix.name: manifest_present

quality_gate_matrix.gap: Populate title, owner_or_supplier, drawing_or_package_id, revision, received_at_utc, and confidentiality.
quality_gate_matrix.name: provenance_complete

quality_gate_matrix.gap: Set source_type to an accepted real-CAD source classification.
quality_gate_matrix.name: real_cad_source_classified

quality_gate_matrix.gap: Stage source CAD files and record exact SHA-256 hashes.
quality_gate_matrix.name: source_cad_hashes_verified

quality_gate_matrix.gap: Stage cleaned geometry files and record exact SHA-256 hashes.
quality_gate_matrix.name: cleaned_geometry_hashes_verified

quality_gate_matrix.gap: Mark large_layout_campaign true and provide at least three real geometries.
quality_gate_matrix.name: large_layout_coverage

quality_gate_matrix.gap: Provide finite meter-space bbox_min_m/bbox_max_m with nondegenerate layout extents.
quality_gate_matrix.name: bbox_non_degenerate_m

quality_gate_matrix.gap: All real-CAD package gates must pass before the production scorecard can clear this blocker.
quality_gate_matrix.name: scorecard_blocker_clearance

title: Engineering H2 Real-CAD Cleanup Package
